## Changelog fragment

- If this PR introduces user-visible or behavior-changing code, please add a changie fragment by running `changie new` and committing the generated file under `changes/unreleased/`.
- PRs that only change documentation, tests, fixtures, or Markdown do not require a fragment.
- To opt out for other reasons, add the `no-changie` label to this PR and explain why in the description; the CI will skip the changie requirement for labeled PRs.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added/updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] I ran `uv run ruff format` and `uv run ty check`
- [ ] I added a changie fragment or explained why this PR is labeled `no-changie`
